title: Tennis: women players of the day
summary: He opines on McEnroe and women tennis players and the greats he watched.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Is jazz healthy? Young players, rock and the future

blocks.x: Just like if you took a football player or even a basketball player and put him up against James McEnroe -- he wouldn't last one second. Not if he was going to chase those balls. Because McEnroe would play with him like a cat with a mouse. That's why... I can't understand why people...why tennis isn't more recognized. It's becoming more...

I mean, they're making so much money now that it's ludicrous. But there have been some girl tennis players that I consider... Like Chris Evert, Tracy Austin, what's the other one...the one with the bun...

You know who I'm talking about. The third one, the little one, the young one... Not one of them has a serve. They just throw the ball way up in the air and wait for it to come down, and they serve. That's the reason why Navratilova pounces on that serve and beats the shit out of them. That's the reason why I can't understand Hannah Mandilakova. There's something wrong with her concentration. She needs a coach, she needs a mentor. Either that, or she needs to get laid. Or something. I don't know what the hell it is. But she needs something, because she's got it all. She is the only one I can think of that could replace Martina.
Now, there's a few coming up! I've seen a couple, Horvath and a few of those, you know. I follow that game, you know...
I know that game. Like, I almost wrote the book. I used to watch Betsy Grant, I watched Wilmer Allison, I watched Tilden -- I watched them all.
Tilden was a monster. I watched Rosewall. He had a beautiful backhand. What a backhand! And of course, Rod Laver. Now you're gettin' into the big words.
But I don't know how we got into that. I always get into tennis some way. It's my second love!
